description: List the compliance information requests (RFIs) Iron/MoonPay has sent the user about their virtual account: status, the open round's questions and any requested documents. Read-only. MoonPay requires the user to answer personally, so NEVER answer on their behalf or draft answers for them to paste: tell them to open the Moneda app at Settings > Features and limits and respond to the information request there. While a request is waiting on a response, transfers may be held.
name: get_information_requests
